from: September book, night 20 (A Little Child Shall Lead)
p1: Isaiah said a new green branch would grow from the roots of Jesse’s family. Jesse was King David’s father.
Jesus was born into that family. Isaiah was talking about Jesus!
Isaiah saw a time of peace Jesus will bring. Prophets teach it will come after He comes again. Even the animals will be gentle.
p2: Today a lamb must stay far from a wolf. But Isaiah said the wolf will live with the lamb. The leopard will lie down with the baby goat. The calf and the young lion will be together. “A little child shall lead them.” No one will hurt anyone.
You can be gentle like that little child. Pat a soft toy, slowly and kindly. Jesus helps you be gentle like Him.
old: Isaiah shared a dream of a beautiful, peaceful world that Heavenly Father is preparing — a world where nothing is scary and everyone is safe.
In this happy place, the wolf and the little lamb lie down together as friends. The lion and the calf rest side by side. No one is afraid anymore!
And guess who leads them all? A little child! “A little child shall lead them,” Isaiah said. Even the smallest one is safe and gentle there.
In Heavenly Father’s peaceful world, no one gets hurt and no one is mean. Everything is filled with kindness, safety, and love.
Heavenly Father wants us to feel that peace even now. When we’re kind and gentle, we bring a little bit of His peaceful world right into our homes today.
